positions.role: Lead paragraph under the H1 of /ru/terrain-map/ and the page's meta description. One TS string.
positions.ruling: SOURCE FIX 2026-11-06 (tr-static-1 source defect on ui.tmap.lead): the old instruction «tap any name in the list to see it on the map» does not match the page. In each list row the NAME is a link that opens the landmark's own page, and the small icon BUTTON beside it (its label is `locate`, shown as a tooltip) flies the map to the place. The lead is also the meta description, so the instruction leaves it: tmap.lead keeps its descriptive sentence(s) only, byte-identical, and the corrected instruction is the NEW key tmap.howto, shown as a second paragraph under the lead. Do not name the icon's shape; call it the button beside the name.
